text:
Maria G.: Quick follow-up from the KV eviction postmortem — we need action owners and test coverage so this doesn't happen again.
Devon K.: I can own the regression suite and promptset curation; goal: initial PR by next Tue.
Maria G.: Please add the PR link to the postmortem and action ticket. cc @sre-bot to file infra ticket.
sre-bot: Created infra/REG-489: 'kv-cache eviction regression + night-load' — https://redwood.example/REG-489
Alex P.: For nightly load: propose a cheap k8s job that runs synthetic traffic (10k tokens/min) plus a chaos pod that triggers cache evictions intermittently.
Sam T.: Promptset should include prefix-heavy, mid-sequence, and long-completion cases — the incident failed mid-sequence.
Devon K.: Regression plan (short): suite ops/kv-eviction-regression; cases: prefix-heavy, long-seq (4k tokens), mixed-concurrency; owners Devon/Alex/Maria; target merge by 2024-07-12.
Maria G.: Add a canary probe checking cache_hit_ratio > 0.85 over 2m with rollback. Alex, can you add snippet to canary config?
Alex P.: Yep — will add probe and a lightweight probe job.
Jonathan S. (via DM): How will we capture flaky prompts?
Devon K.: Failing prompts copied to artifacts bucket; nightly job replays them first and tags owners; retention 90d.
Sam T.: Add a quarterly chaos drill simulating KV evictions during peak load; owner Sam.
Devon K.: Also include model variants (fp16, q4) as an axis in regression matrix — correlated in incident.
Maria G.: I'll pin a checklist to REG-489 and request daily progress updates until closed. target closure 2024-07-19.
sre-bot: Scheduled nightly job ops/kv-eviction-regression -> cron 0 03 * * *.
Devon K.: Opening initial PR and will tag owners. Thanks.
Alex P.: +1 :rocket:
Sam T.: Adding chaos steps to runbook.
Maria G.: Owners recap: Devon (regression + promptset), Alex (nightly & canary probes), Sam (chaos drill), Maria (postmortem gating & updates). Ping here if blocked.
